pages.text: The hatchery is the swarm's heart: larvae become cocoons, cocoons become units; a drone turns INTO a building. The lair stands 480 blocks from where you first appeared, ringed by its buildings, with tunnels and halls of eggs beneath.

Creep spreads round hatcheries and tumors: on it zerg run faster and heal. Wild zerg hate every living thing, raid villages, dig tunnels and claim caves with flesh and tumors. Nydus corridors run from the base: a long tunnel of liquid creep to a nydus worm, through which warriors are sent and guarded.
